messages.subject: Error in Maaslin
parts:
Hello,
          Recently, I encountered a difference while doing Maalsin analysis.
I have 20 metadata to analyze. When I used all these 20 metadata together to see the association with microbiota. I got less association with this 20 metadata.
But when I put only 10 metadata with microbiota in maaslin.pcl file and run maaslin again. Surprisingly I got more number of association. I was thinking the number of metadata does not matter because Maaslin runs for each metadata with each relative abundance of microbiota.
Since I am a newbie in bioinformatic tools, kindly someone can clarify why it is happening and which way is better to do?

Thanks,
Khem
